question: Why is the deity called Vāma in this act of manifestation?
premises: The deity has consciousness as its one body.
The deity desires to make the universe its own within the consciousness-self.
This occurs through the emission of its own power of awareness.
inference: Because of this self-emitting appropriation of the universe, that deity is called Vāma.
plain_english: That God, whose one body is consciousness, desiring to make the universe his own within the self of consciousness by emitting his own power of awareness, is called Vāma.
